final_preexecution_disposition.meaning: Independent source review supports the already-authorized narrow harmless diagnostic; this is not a human approval object and does not grant additional execution scope.
final_preexecution_disposition.allowed_reviewed_scope: Exactly the fixed live diagnostic at the stated revision, Pre/Main/StopPost attestation, eight Main business phases, one inert child, bounded volatile scratch and stdout protocol. final_preexecution_disposition.first_failure_action: Preserve original raw receipts and stop all dependent tests; no alternate settings, retry, replacement seed, privilege escalation or resource increase.
